title: VistaShares launches Treasury ETF with options-based Bitcoin exposure
summary: The NYSE-listed BTYB allocates most of its assets to US Treasurys while using options strategies to provide weekly income and Bitcoin-linked exposure.

title: Spain to follow UK with plans to ban social media for children under 16
summary: Pedro Sánchez announced that Spain would implement several changes to laws impacting social media platforms starting next week, with potential criminal liability for executives.

title: Bitcoin, crypto 'winter' soon over, says BitWise exec as gold retargets $5K
summary: Bitcoin failed to attack $80,000 resistance as gold sought a $5,000 reclaim, while analysis argued that "crypto winter" began in January 2025.

title: World Liberty launches $3.4B stablecoin: How it fits into onchain credit systems
summary: World Liberty launches a $3.4-billion stablecoin and lending platform, positioning it within onchain credit, collateralized loans and DeFi markets.

title: Did Solana bottom at $100? SOL price charts hint at a 150% rally
summary: Solana price technicals suggest that the recent correction to $100 was a buy-the-dip opportunity as traders look for a recovery path toward $260.

title: MetaMask adds tokenized US stocks, ETFs, commodities via Ondo
summary: The rollout provides access to tokenized US stocks, ETFs and commodities through Ondo GM tokens for non-US users on Ethereum, excluding 30 jurisdictions at launch.

title: Rails taps Stellar to launch onchain vaults for institutional derivatives liquidity
summary: Rails is betting that Stellar‑based smart contract vaults, onchain proofs and segregated collateral can make high‑speed perpetuals more palatable to institutions.

title: Fireblocks integrates Canton Network for regulated onchain settlement
summary: The integration allows institutions to custody and settle assets on the privacy-enabled blockchain built for regulated financial markets.

title: Suspicious projects outpublish legitimate ones in crypto press releases
summary: A new report finds most crypto press releases come from high-risk projects, raising questions about disclosure, hype and market manipulation.

title: Spanish Red Cross launches privacy-first blockchain aid platform
summary: The Spanish Red Cross is rolling out RedChain, a privacy-preserving blockchain aid system that gives donors cryptographic proof of impact without exposing beneficiary identities.
